sections.title: How the population has changed in Fife
sections.label: Select another local authority

sections.content: In 2024, Fife was the third largest local authority in Scotland, with a population of just over 370,000. Its population increased by 0.3% compared with 2023, and has increased by 7.1% since 2001.

sections.title: Population density in Fife
sections.content: In 2024, the population density in Fife was 283 people per square kilometre, which was more than Scotland (71), and less than the United Kingdom as a whole (285).

sections.title: Median age in Fife
sections.content: In 2024, the median age in Fife was 44 years, which was older than Scotland (42 years), and older than the United Kingdom as a whole (40 years).
